voiceGuide: Help children identify the fish with the highest weight number. Encourage careful comparison of numbers. Celebrate correct catches and gently guide on mistakes.

welcome.text: Welcome, little fisher! Let's catch some heavy fish!

instructions.text: Tap the fish with the biggest number — that's the heaviest one!

correct_1.text: Great catch! That fish is a whopper!

correct_2.text: Awesome! You found the heaviest one!

correct_3.text: Wow, nice catch! You're a fishing pro!

correct_4.text: That's the big one! Amazing job!

correct_5.text: Superb! You picked the heaviest fish!

wrong_1.text: Oops! That fish is too light. Try again!

wrong_2.text: Not quite! Look for a bigger number.

wrong_3.text: Hmm, that one's small. Find the heaviest!

encouragement_3.text: Nice work, fisher! A few more to go!

win.text: You did it! What an amazing fisher you are!

try_again.text: Good effort! Want to try again and beat your score?

perfect_score.text: Incredible! You got every single one right! You're a fishing champion!
